title: Ilizwi Elalingafuni Ukuphelelwa Lithemba
intro: Ngena endlwini apho ukulahlekelwa kulandela ukulahlekelwa, kodwa ilizwi elinye elizolileyo liyala ukuphelelwa lithemba. Ubizo olunye kwiQur'an luguqula umonde ube yinguquko; ungalulandela umkhondo womntu ongasemva kwelo lizwi?
clues: Ndandililizwi lomonde ngaphakathi kwikhaya apho iintsikelelo zazivavanywa yintlekele.
Ndahlala endlwini engenabantu ngenxa yokulahlekelwa bubutyebi nabantwana.
Bendisazi ukuba ukugula kuye kwahlasela nalo mhlobo, umzimba wakhe wawuchaphazelekile.
Xa ukubandezeleka kwaba nzima, ndamemeza ndimkhumbuza uAllah.
Ndavakalisa isibhengezo esinye: UAllah yiNyaniso, ngoko ke hlala unomonde.
Ndabiza u-Ayyub ngegama; emva koko, u-Allah wayisusa intlungu waza wabuyisela usapho.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukuhlala no-Ayyub ngexesha lokulahlekelwa nokugula, uze ucele umonde
Isilumkiso sesithunywa esilungileyo ukuba sishiye uluntu olukhohlakeleyo
trial.answer: Ukuhlala no-Ayyub ngexesha lokulahlekelwa nokugula, uze ucele umonde

location.label: Into ephambili
options: Ukuvakaliswa kokuba uAllah uyiNyaniso kwaye umonde uyafuneka
Iphupha leenkwenkwezi ezilishumi elinanye kunye nelanga eliphumayo
location.answer: Ukuvakaliswa kokuba uAllah uyiNyaniso kwaye umonde uyafuneka

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Intlungu ka-Ayyub yasuswa kwaye usapho lwakhe lwabuyiselwa kwimeko yalo
Umntwana obelindelwe ixesha elide waphiwa emva komthandazo ongenabantwana
Umlawuli oselula watolika iminyaka esixhenxe yendyebo kunye nokunqongophala
outcome.answer: Intlungu ka-Ayyub yasuswa kwaye usapho lwakhe lwabuyiselwa kwimeko yalo

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
